sloka: समागता त्वम् रामेण मोदिष्यसि महात्मना ।सुवर्षेण समायुक्ता यथा सस्येन मेदिनी ।। ६-३३-३८।।
transliteration: samāgatā tvam rāmeṇa modiṣyasi mahātmanā ।suvarṣeṇa samāyuktā yathā sasyena medinī ।। 6-33-38।।

translations.english: "Just as the earth becomes green with crops blessed with good monsoon, so also you will become joyful by seeing the great soul Rama's heroism."
